description: ``install [opts] src dst`` and ``rsync [opts] src... dst`` both write the destination as the final positional, but ``_CP_MV_RE`` matched only ``cp|mv``. install is the standard packaging verb (sets perms + copy in one step); rsync is ubiquitous in deploy scripts. Either verb against a protected destination passed before the fix. Fix: ``_INSTALL_CMD_RE`` and ``_RSYNC_CMD_RE`` capture the full argument span, and ``_last_non_flag_token`` picks the final positional in Python — this handles both separate flag values (``-s 0``, ``-e ssh``) and glued ones (``-p1``) without a brittle flag-arg-counting regex.
